description: This Java source file defines the ModifyConfig class, which represents a command to modify an actor's configuration within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and updating headers, as well as managing the configuration data.

classes.name: ModifyConfig
classes.description: Represents a command to modify an actor's configuration, including mechanisms for creation, JSON serialization, and header management.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ModifyConfig instance with the specified configuration JSON object and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a ModifyConfig instance from a JSON object and headers, extracting the 'config' field.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration JSON object associated with this command.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new ModifyConfig instance with the provided Ditto headers.
